reason: VerifyMessageProperties.java:70 and :79 wrap read failures in a raw RuntimeException, while verify() at :52-53 uses MojoExecutionException. The English file path comes from replaceAll on the absolute path (:74-75), so a bundle with no _en sibling crashes with an unchecked exception instead of producing a clean mojo error. This is why the patch renamed duplicate_keys.properties to duplicateKeys_en.properties.
